cv.name: Tegan Matthews
cv.headline: Electrical Engineer – HV/LV design for water and resources infrastructure
cv.summary: Electrical engineer with about seven years of design and site experience in power distribution, water treatment and resources projects. Returned to work in 2023 after two years caring for a family member, and now lead electrical design packages for water infrastructure upgrades.

experience.title: Electrical Engineer
bullets: Lead LV and HV design for pump station and treatment plant upgrades for a state water utility
Produce cable sizing, protection settings and arc flash studies in ETAP
Review contractor drawings and witness FAT and SAT for switchboards and MCCs
Prepared a design standard template that cut drawing review cycles on recent projects

experience.title: Career break
bullets: Primary carer for a parent; completed an online refresher in AS/NZS 3000:2018 changes

experience.title: Electrical Engineer
bullets: Design of 22 kV and 415 V distribution for mine site camps and processing plants
Site supervision during commissioning in the Goldfields

experience.title: Graduate Electrical Engineer
bullets: Rotations through protection, maintenance planning and project engineering
